text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Each product's mean absolute error minus ERA5's, on January to September of one calendar year. August to December 2024, five months, is too short for an interval and is left out. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months. Capacity is each generator's 99th-percentile output. Three wind farms in Lincolnshire, August 2024 to September 2026. All rows are exploratory.'
